entity_raw.definition_raw:
When you’re in the company of other aliens, your thoughts become difficult to follow.

Prerequisite(s): Android, kasatha, lashunta, or triaxian.

Benefit(s): Whenever you’re adjacent to at least one other android, kasatha, lashunta, or triaxian ally who also has this feat, you gain a +4 circumstance bonus on saves against mind-affecting effects and divination (scrying) effects, unless the effect comes from an android, kasatha, lashunta, or triaxian.
